question: Can an initially quiescent prepared guide transfer a source perturbation to two local counter clocks and finite internal records under the unchanged Rule3 engine?
candidate: Existing 2O body-013 coupling, signs +++; only initial channel triples vary between controls.
preparation: Background (0,0,2); source channels 0/14 are (0,1,2)/(0,-1,2); receivers j=1..N are (0,0,4)/(0,0,0). Origin=(L//2-N//2,L//2,L//2). No changes after t=0.

observation.signal: First b0!=0 at receiver j; predicted arrival t=j in complete-guide preparations.
observation.clock: Channel-0 counter pair at t=j+k equals [(0,1),(1,0),(0,-1),(-1,0)][k mod 4] within the first record window; channel14 counters have opposite signs.
observation.click: Rising edge M(t-1)=0,M(t)=1, read only after evolution. Distinct from the existing arithmetic C0/C1/C2 observer.
observation.retention: For each detector j: M=1 exactly throughout the first window j <= t < 2(N+1)-j, then M=0 at its endpoint. No permanence or later exclusivity criterion is imposed.
observation.composition: Both predefined detector positions satisfy arrival, counter-cycle and first-window retention in the same trajectory.
observation.visualization: Read-only projection of actual a,b,r; counter phase never replaces exact displayed integers. Gears display the exact identity 2u+r=6ell+r_next. Playback does not evolve or alter the model.

Clock starts, fixed memory readout fails

budget.policy: Stop and report inconclusive if exceeded; do not reinterpret exhaustion as impossibility.

acceptance: Every expected prepared/held-out detector passes exact arrival, period-four projection and declared first-window retention.
Every source-absent state equals its initial complete state; source-only control produces no detector click.
Gap control prevents activation/record at j=12 throughout the fixed horizon; it is an initial-state transfer contrast, not a demonstrated autonomous control-signal clutch.
Odd remainder at j=6 prevents the exact memory predicate by parity while clock activation is separately measured; this expected limitation is a scientific failure of parity robustness.
Every transition has an exact inverse, every full trajectory rewinds, and complete normalized traces match between the two N24 sizes.
No active update crosses a periodic boundary in these complete trajectories.
The published replay is generated from retained states and reproduces the declared gear identities; no synthetic trajectory is substituted.
failure: Any unmet registered criterion remains visible and blocks an overall pass; do not change the observer or expected duration after inspection.
next_decision: Successful prepared composition licenses bounded search for an autonomous control-signal clutch and broader preparation robustness. Physical light, stable matter and quantum measurement remain unestablished.
